notes: Ranged combat organised around a crosshair, damage falloff and AI waves is Shooter, and PvE Shooter is the only preset in the file that is not a PvP mode, so it is the mode match; the roguelite XP, levels and three-card upgrades are progression with no layout expression, so no second genre is doing real work worth naming. I swapped the preset's lane-network for space-bounded because the author was asked and chose an open ruined block with obstacles rather than strict lanes, and rejected open-battlefield too since they called it one compact block and a focused test arena rather than a large map of dispersed points of interest. Kept spawner-npc for the designated enemy spawn points and choke-bottleneck bent to the pinch points that wreckage and collapsed buildings form for pathfinding crawlers, dropped building-interior because nothing puts the player indoors and P3 would cost a modifier the brief never asked for. With no user to ask I added cover-los for the concrete barriers, abandoned vehicles and rubble the prompt lists, took a squad of up to 4 as the spawn count to size the arena, and treated fog, flickering lights and the HUD as presentation rather than layout.
